<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the most plausible molecular formula is C₈H₁₀O (neutral mass ≈ 122.07 Da, matching the observed m/z ≈ 121.05 Da as the [M–H]⁻ ion). A common structure with this formula is phenethyl alcohol (2‑phenylethanol), SMILES = c1ccccc1CCO. This fits the DBE count, the carbon count inferred from the isotopic pattern, and is a reasonable small organic molecule that could be present in a laboratory sample.</thought>
<final_answer>c1ccccc1CCO</final_answer>
